name: nature-writing-studio
title_zh: 657 篇 Nature 原文蒸馏出的学术英语改写器
tagline_zh: 投 Nature 前，摘要和引言总被批「不够 native」。它用 657 篇原文逐篇观察出的语料库改写。
tagline_en: Before you submit, your abstract gets flagged 'not native'. This rewrites using patterns from 657 Nature.
desc_en: Rewrite scientific text into Nature Portfolio English using a knowledge base distilled from 657 Nature family papers via per-paper LLM observation (87.6% coverage), now extended with 5 deterministic AI-observation TSVs (gap_transitions / opener_distribution / cross_section_linkers / hedge_verbs / results_discussion_openers) from 412 v3 Nature papers via MiniMax-M3 per-paper observation. why_en: Not generic polishing—a per-paper observation KB with 87.6% coverage, plus 5 deterministic TSVs for gap transitions, openers.
limit_zh: 只改写科学文本为 Nature Portfolio 风格，不生成新内容；需输入英文或可翻译的学术草稿；不处理图表。
limit_en: Rewrites only scientific text into Nature Portfolio style; no new content generation. Needs English or translatable draft. No figures/references.
title_en: Nature-style English rewriter distilled from 657 papers
